name: Beef Pasties
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cups (400 g) cubed cooking roast beef, in ¼-inch (65 mm) pieces
½ cup (120 mL) diced cooked onion
Pastry for double crust pie (9-inch or 22 cm)

steps: Combine beef, potatoes, broth, onion, parsley, thyme, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out ¼ of the pastry into an 8-inch (20 cm) circle.
Mound 1 cup (240 mL) of filling on half of circle.
Moisten edge of pastry with water.
Fold dough over filling. Crimp edges with fork to seal.
Repeat with remaining pastry and filling.
Cut slits in top of each completed pastry.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.

culture.text: A pasty is a British baked turnover, a variety of which is particularly associated with Cornwall and Devon but has spread all over the United Kingdom and elsewhere through the Cornish diaspora. It consists of a filling, typically meat and vegetables, baked in a folded and crimped shortcrust pastry circle.
